messages:
maya.docs: quick sync — I opened a PR that attempts to clarify the mapping between query metrics and dashboard tiles. link: <https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/12456|PR#12456>
ethan.devex: saw it, skimmed. can you add a tiny example showing metric -> trace attribute crosswalk? folks get confused about cost vs latency labels.
maya.docs: yeah planning to. thinking of adding a small snippet like:
```yaml
# metric query example (Metrics v2)
metric: redwood.request.duration_ms
group_by: [route, model]
aggregate: p50
filters:
  - env: production
```
rosa.eng-obs: that helps. also we should call out the pairings: cost token_count -> trace.span.tokens, latency duration_ms -> trace.span.runtime_ms. otherwise dashboard teams map to the wrong field.
ben.sdk: can we also include a short code sample for the SDK trace hook so folks know how attributes are emitted? small JS example: `redwood.trace.addAttributes({ tokens: tokenCount, model: "redwood/fast-7b" })`
maya.docs: good point. i'll add both YAML query and the JS snippet. will also add a note about quoting numeric fields in some dashboard UIs.
ethan.devex: one nag: the PR currently references metrics v1 examples in one spot (line ~78). we should either update or flag for deprecation.
maya.docs: thanks — I'll replace the v1 example with a migration note. proposed text: "If your org still uses metrics v1, map redwood.request.latency -> redwood.request.duration_ms and update aggregation functions accordingly."
rosa.eng-obs: also include a tiny troubleshooting section: common reasons metrics don't show up — 1) missing trace attr key, 2) sampled traces only (sampling rate), 3) dashboard cache TTL.
ben.sdk: can we add a small test snippet for the trace hook to validate attributes locally? e.g.
```js
// run locally to assert attribute presence
const span = mockTrace.startSpan('test');
span.setAttribute('tokens', 42);
assert(span.attributes.tokens === 42);
```
maya.docs: yes. i'll upstream both test snippet and troubleshooting bullets.
deploy-bot: PR#12456 updated — CI: docs-lint passed, link-check failed for one external link (<https://old-redwood-docs.example/metrics-v1>)
ethan.devex: replace the external link with the internal migration anchor instead. don't want stale external refs.
maya.docs: done — swapped to /docs/migration/metrics-v1-to-v2#field-mapping and pushed.
rosa.eng-obs: quick question: should we show a sample dashboard tile config for cost breakdown (per-model) or link to existing cost widget? we have a cost widget example but it doesn't show per-model grouping.
maya.docs: i'll add a short per-model cost tile example that uses `group_by: model` and `sum(token_cost)` aggregate. small caveat about sample currency unit.
ben.sdk: LGTM. can you also add a one-line callout for Dedicated vs Hosted differences re: trace ingestion latency — people ask why hosted shows slightly different timings.
maya.docs: noted — adding a small note under "Platform caveats". plan: fold changes into PR and request reviews from @rosa.eng-obs and @ethan.devex.
ethan.devex: assigning review now. also leave a TODO to run the new snippets through the snippet runner before merge.
maya.docs: PR updated with all snippets + troubleshooting + migration note. requesting reviews. thanks all :sparkles:
